page.title: Connections
page.description: Show your events and todos from hocX in Apple Calendar or Google Calendar. The calendars update automatically – you keep editing in hocX.

events.title: Events
events.description: All events of {tenant} as a separate calendar.

todos.title: Todos
todos.description: Todos with a due date as all-day entries – open ones with ☐, completed ones with ✓.

options.hideDetailsHelp: Without description, location and names. Google stores subscribed calendars on its own servers.

url.label: Subscription URL
url.help: This address is secret: anyone who knows it can read the calendar. Generate a new URL if in doubt.

meta.neverAccessed: Not fetched by a calendar app yet

invalid: This URL is no longer valid because you signed out everywhere or changed your password. Generate a new URL and set up the subscription again.

confirm.regenerate: The current URL will stop working. You will need to set up existing subscriptions in Apple or Google again.
confirm.remove: The calendar will no longer update in Apple or Google. Remove the subscription there manually as well.

toasts.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

howto.title: How to set it up
howto.apple: Apple (iPhone, iPad, Mac): tap “Apple Calendar” and confirm the subscription. It refreshes about every hour.
howto.google: Google: open “Google Calendar” and add it. Google only reloads subscribed calendars every few hours – changes show up with a delay.
howto.android: Android: use the Google option – the calendar then also appears in the calendar app on your phone.
howto.readOnly: The connection works in one direction: you make changes in hocX, not in the calendar.

hint.events: Show events in Apple or Google Calendar
hint.todos: Show todos in Apple or Google Calendar
